name: Offer change-approval gate (executing → awaiting_approval)
description:
First human gate. When a run's generated OpenSpec change has been authored and blessed by the CLI validator (openspec.validated present) but no human approval exists yet (run.change_approved absent), move the run to awaiting_approval so the dev loop cannot start. This encodes the validate-before-approval ordering (G-io task 4.4/3.7): approval is only offered after the change is OpenSpec-valid. The transition is rule-owned (G2) — no product Go fires it. CONTRACT (design D15): this rule evaluates conditions against the RUN entity, so group 4's validate harness MUST stamp openspec.validated on the run entity (subject = agent.run.entity_id), not on the loop or a change entity, or this rule never fires and the run wedges silently.

CONTENT-FRESH (design D15 forward-contract #0): openspec.validated carries the change's content REVISION, and create_change stamps the run's current revision at openspec.change.revision (slug-independent, so this slug-blind rule can read it). The gate fires only when openspec.validated EQUALS openspec.change.revision — so after a rework re-author bumps openspec.change.revision, the stale openspec.validated no longer matches and the gate will NOT offer approval until validate_change runs again against the new content and re-stamps the matching revision. This closes the stale-same-slug false-green: without it a re-authored change could reach the human gate on a prior version's validation.

on_enter.reason: change authored and OpenSpec-validated; awaiting human change approval
